title: Observed-synapse table (per morphology)
status_note: must be regenerated against the pruned bank.
row_meaning: one row per observed synapse on morphology nu

fields.name: x
fields.meaning: position in the aligned cell frame; THE DURABLE GROUND TRUTH

fields.name: synapse_label
fields.note: this is the 'other column'. It lives HERE, not in a section name. Sharing the slot is defect O8.

fields.name: lfpy_idx
fields.meaning: s; a CACHED LOOKUP, valid only for the (nu, Lambda) recorded in the same row
fields.note: NOT a key. After pruning and merging one segment hosts many synapses; this is many-to-one and must be recomputed whenever (nu, Lambda) changes.

fields.name: spine_base_section
fields.meaning: for a synapse that sat on a pruned spine: the shaft section containing that spine's base, recorded BEFORE pruning
fields.note: re-attachment must use this recorded base, never a geometric snap: a spine head sits roughly 2 um from its own shaft and in dense EM neuropil is frequently closer to a DIFFERENT neuron's dendrite, so nearest-neighbour would silently relocate synapses onto the wrong branch and the model would run without complaint.

fields.name: lambda_f
fields.note: must equal the C-08 row for the same nu (I-13b)

fields.name: nsegs_method
fields.note: must equal the C-08 row for the same nu (I-13b)
